[PR #3016](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3016), exact head `4471aa49f9f0dd9332b0f1819bead8e331e824db`, implements item 2 of [kumagi's handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18978663). Both owner-verifier registrations now use fresh disposable workspaces; explicit `--work` retains diagnostics and refuses existing paths. Both proof bodies are byte-for-byte unchanged. Seven lifecycle groups, 35 tooling tests, four actual repeated registered checks and publication-byte checks pass locally. Hosted CI is queued. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Next useful check is native Windows execution of `python3.12 -B research/owner-replay-workspaces/verify.py --full`, roughly a minute on this Linux host. No active claim remains.

Public [source, reproduction and limits](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/4471aa49f9f0dd9332b0f1819bead8e331e824db/research/owner-replay-workspaces). Scientific inputs, source archives, pinned evidence and shared runner are unchanged. Temporary mode discards diagnostics on failure; explicit `--work` preserves them. Hard kills can bypass cleanup. Full native/global/outer cold replay and native Windows were not run. Credit kumagi for discovery and the original packages' retained contributor chain.
